about.title: Achieve Together
about.intro1Text: is a social platform for creating and tracking activities, sharing achievements, and communicating with other users. The service helps people showcase their progress, find like-minded individuals, and grow together.
about.intro2Text: of the project are activities, publications, and communication. Their combination forms the core functionality of the service: sharing achievements through private messages and posts, managing activities together in groups or pairs, reposting content from other users, and providing opportunities to showcase interests, goals, and results.
about.intro3Text: of the project is to help people find like-minded individuals, share achievements, recognize the success of others, unite around common interests, and support one another in reaching their goals.
about.aboutProjectText: The project is currently under active development and beta testing. Some features may change, be improved, or temporarily work unstably.
about.warningText: The project is in an early stage of development. Although the author pays attention to security, the current version of the service does not guarantee absolute data protection. It is not recommended to publish or transfer confidential information, passwords, or other sensitive data through the service.

about.futureText: Future versions will expand the social aspects of the platform and improve existing functionality.
about.future1: A full-featured text editor for creating posts with text formatting support
about.future2: Support for bold text, italics, headings, lists, and other formatting elements
about.future3: Adding images directly inside post content
about.future4: Dedicated pages for publications with convenient content viewing
about.commercialText: At the moment, Achieve Together is a non-commercial project and is being developed independently.

contacts.supportText1: If you have questions, suggestions, feedback, or found a bug in Achieve Together, you can contact us.
contacts.supportText2: We are open to feedback and suggestions for the development of the project.
contacts.aboutProjectText: Achieve Together is currently in beta testing. We continue to develop the service by adding new features for communication, publications, and jointly achieving goals.
